"'''Journey to the Bottom of Naboo / Speeder Surprise'''" is the third episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Three|third season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[December 8]], [[2025]].

==Official description==
''The Jedi race a [[Tooba Jinx|thief]]. [[Kai Brightstar|Kai]] helps a lost cub.''<ref name="Journey to the Bottom of Naboo / Speeder Surprise" />
